p.i: Tota ipsa (gens) propter rapinam veniet: Oppositio faciei eorum (similis erit) uento Orientali: Congregabitq;[?] tanquam arenam captiuitatem.

main_text.p: Tria hoc loco praenuntiantur, de quibus σὺν θεῷ[?] nobis agendum erit.
1. Quod sit destinatum Chaldaeorū, uidelicet, prædis agendis, & aliis spoliandis, opes suas augere.De facultatibus.
2. Quòd ἀνυπόστατοις[?] illis nulla ui humana resisti possit? non certè magis quàm olera uirentia resistere possunt Orientali uento, qui uehementissimus est.
3. Quòd multa hominum millia in captiuitatem sint abducturi.De personis.
main_text.head: 1. DE CHALDAEORUM rapinis.
main_text.p: Transgressoribus legis inter alias poenas, etiam hæc uoce diuina denunciatur: Adducet Iehouah gentem robustā facie, quæ non eleuabit faciem ad senem, nec puero parcet: Et deuorabit fructum iumenti tui, & fructum terræ tuæ, donec disperdaris: quæ nō relinquet tibi frumentum, uinū nouū, & oleum, nec primogeni

page.notes: Left margin notes are placed in the paragraphs they stand beside. The Greek words σὺν θεῷ and ἀνυπόστατοις are doubtful and marked [?]. The "q" sign after "Congregabit" is doubtful and marked [?]. The catchword "tum" is printed at the lower right. The Greek in the 2nd paragraph may be misread. Printed "alijs" and "VERSVS" were normalised to i and u by the rules.
